comment: The effective OCR languages of a dataset. Order: the dataset row, the collection default row, the installation default. A deleted row is a tombstone. The version is the newest row read, tombstones included, and 0 without a row. Read by tests/unit/test_ocr_resolution.py and by the dataset_ocr tests of the website backend. A row is [value, deleted, version_us].

cases.name: no rows use the installation default
a collection default applies to a dataset without its own row
a dataset row overrides the collection default
an empty EasyOCR dataset row turns EasyOCR off
an empty EasyOCR collection default turns EasyOCR off for inheriting datasets
a reset dataset row inherits the collection default with the reset version
a deleted collection default falls back to the installation with its version
a newer collection default does not change a dataset override or its version
